mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationProject*/ SELECT PROJECT_NAME, BURQ_NO, KEP_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ02' AND CODE = PROJECT_STATUS) AS PROJECT_STATUS_NAME, PROJECT_TYPE, PROJECT_UNIT, PROJECT_MNG_USER, BURQ_INPUT_IMAGE_KEY, BURQ_OUTPUT_IMAGE_KEY, SG_START_SCHD_DATE, TO_CHAR(SG_START_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS SG_START_DATE, RFQ_START_SCHD_DATE, TO_CHAR(RFQ_START_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RFQ_START_DATE, RFQ_END_SCHD_DATE, TO_CHAR(RFQ_END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RFQ_END_DATE, RFQ_MERGE_SCHD_DATE, TO_CHAR(RFQ_MERGE_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RFQ_MERGE_DATE, RFQ_SUBMIT_SCHD_DATE, TO_CHAR(RFQ_SUBMIT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RFQ_SUBMIT_DATE, RFQ_APPROVAL_SCHD_DATE, TO_CHAR(RFQ_APPROVAL_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RFQ_APPROVAL_DATE, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BURQ_ITEM A WHERE BURQ_NO = A.BURQ_NO),0,'Y','N') AS UNIT_YN, PROJECT_STATUS, TO_CHAR((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BURQ_ITEM WHERE BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no})) AS ITEM_CNT FROM KEP_BURQ_MNG WHERE BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no}

/*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationDetailSheetPop1*/ SELECT 'C' AS STATUS, A.BUYER, NVL((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER),(SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = A.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, TEXT1 AS PROCESS_TYPE, TEXT2 AS PARCEL_YN, TEXT3 AS WAREHOUSE FROM ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE AS BUYER, TEXT1, TEXT2, TEXT3 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = #{st_burq_no} ) A

/*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationDetailSheetPop2*/ SELECT SG_ID, (SELECT SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG B WHERE A.SG_ID = B.SG_ID) AS SG_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = SM_USER_ID) AS SM_USER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, -- 대상건수 SUM(REQ_CNT) AS REQ_CNT, -- 요청건수 SUM(RES_CNT) AS RES_CNT, -- 회신건수 SUM(AMT) AS AMT -- 기준 금액 FROM ( SELECT NVL(SG_ID, ' ') AS SG_ID, NVL(SM_USER_ID, ' ') AS SM_USER_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = ITEM.BURQ_NO AND RFQ.ITEM_KEY_ID = ITEM.ITEM_KEY_ID AND ATOS_DATE IS NOT NULL) AS REQ_CNT, -- 각 품목별 요청건수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = ITEM.BURQ_NO AND RFQ.ITEM_KEY_ID = ITEM.ITEM_KEY_ID AND CH_LIST_PRICE IS NOT NULL) AS RES_CNT, -- 각 품목별 회신건수 RE_LIST_PRICE * NVL(ITEM_QTY,1) AS AMT FROM KEP_BURQ_ITEM ITEM WHERE BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no} ) A GROUP BY SG_ID, SM_USER_ID

/*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationDetailSheetPopNotice*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, NOTICE_TYPE, NOTICE_REMARK, SEQ, 'C' AS NOTICE_STATUS FROM KEP_BURQ_NOTC WHERE BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no} AND NOTICE_TYPE = #{st_notice_type} AND NOTICE_STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY SEQ
mapper.update: /*updateBulkQuotationProject*/ UPDATE KEP_BURQ_MNG SET PROJECT_NAME = #{st_project_name}, PROJECT_MNG_USER = #{st_project_mng_user}, PROJECT_UNIT = #{st_project_unit}, KEP_DEPT = #{st_kep_dept}, SG_START_SCHD_DATE = #{st_sg_start_schd_date}, RFQ_START_SCHD_DATE = #{st_rfq_start_schd_date}, RFQ_END_SCHD_DATE = #{st_rfq_end_schd_date}, RFQ_MERGE_SCHD_DATE = #{st_rfq_merge_schd_date}, RFQ_SUBMIT_SCHD_DATE = #{st_rfq_submit_schd_date}, RFQ_APPROVAL_SCHD_DATE = #{st_rfq_approval_schd_date}, BURQ_INPUT_IMAGE_KEY = #{st_image_key}, BURQ_OUTPUT_IMAGE_KEY = #{st_image_key2}, PROJECT_END_DATE = #{st_rfq_approval_schd_date}, CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE, CHANGE_USER_ID = #{USER_ID} WHERE BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no}

INSERT INTO KEP_BURQ_NOTC (BURQ_NO,NOTICE_TYPE,SEQ,NOTICE_STATUS,NOTICE_REMARK,ADD_DATE,ADD_USER_ID,CHANGE_DATE,CHANGE_USER_ID) VALUES ( #{st_burq_no}, #{NOTICE_TYPE}, #{st_seq}, 'C', #{NOTICE_REMARK}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID} )
